reviews.boundary_analysis: New NgModules require genuine integration/legacy dependency need; a standalone misconfiguration is repaired rather than bypassed. These narrower exceptions are explicit prior claims.

Route pages coordinate, reusable presentation components use explicit inputs and meaningful events. No trivial-logic extraction merely to shrink components; union covers both behavioral role and anti-refactoring gate.
Explicit HTTP boundary is an alternative to a specifically named service; frontend contract models rather than backend Domain imports are mandatory. Baseline retains both alternative and domain ban.

Computed for derived state and avoidance of effect when clearer alternatives exist are specific additional guidance already registered. Neither newer API nor universal Observable conversion justifies selection.
Meaningful route lazy loading is the default; tiny components excluded. Memoization, virtual scrolling and change-detection work follow actual need, already registered.

Leaf state-library gate requires demonstrated application complexity, while baseline start choices include component, Signals, feature service/store and RxJS. Explicitly represented beyond canonical simple-state preference.

Absolute no global technical buckets/empty folders is already registered. Two components in one feature do not justify shared; shared is cross-feature, and backend boundary rules cannot be mechanically imposed. All separate scope constraints have prior claims.

Class-based interceptors need a reason in the leaf while functional new-code default and absolute cross-cutting/no-business-logic constraints remain. Named provider setup and conditional class exception are registered.

Leaf centralization becomes unconditional when backend ProblemDetails is used, stronger than canonical when-practical, already BF-0097. Stable status/type/code branching does not turn optional code extension into a mandatory field; existing U0003 is not resolved by frontend consumption guidance.

Typed controls and explicit request mapping are registered. Complex Domain-rule duplication requires genuine UI need; synchronized messages do not transfer backend integrity/security authority to frontend.

Leaf compose-with-operators instead of nesting is already represented in primary0243; canonical clearer-composition condition remains in replica0130. No fresh stronger clause is missing from the union.

Framework-lifecycle tie is required for manual subscriptions; removing them through async pipe/toSignal is conditionally preferred. Both independently registered. debounceTime300 in example is not promoted to a timing policy.
